text: [E] "One round trip: Parse + Bind + Describe(portal) + Execute + Sync in one flush, including behind poolers. FS-06 confirms on every pooler".
[V] "Supabase documentation and the Supavisor FAQ disagree on named prepared statements in transaction mode. The `supavisor` profile is conservative until FS-06 measures it."
[V] "PgBouncer 1.26 reports `pgbouncer.*` values through ParameterStatus at login, which allows pooler detection without an extra query."
[V] "RDS Proxy pins a session on any `SET` and on query text above 16 KB, and has no session pinning filters for PostgreSQL." (hosted: Not verifiable here unless a URL is supplied)

[V] "Cloudflare documents Hyperdrive as supporting named prepared statements as implemented by postgres.js and node-postgres. OKDriver must reproduce a compatible message sequence and test it live." (Not verifiable here)
P10-T02 acceptance: "No 26000 or 42P05 errors across the conformance run through each pooler; passive detection where the pooler reports itself". Record which pooler and configuration produce them.
